# Synthetic CLI baseline fixtures

All project names, rules, evidence, and history contents here are synthetic. Tests
copy repositories into unique temporary directories and remove them on drop;
commands must never index or snapshot these source directories in place.

| Repository | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `standard` | Default init layout, including core files, all collection indexes, active/completed plans, active/archived worklogs, references, and an excluded template. |
| `flat` | Root-level decisions, execution plan, principles, and singular `reference/`, all routed from `AGENTS.md`. |
| `cjk` | Chinese body text, mixed Chinese/English titles, and identifiers `EV-01` and `GD-02`. Short body terms intentionally do not appear in the first-paragraph summary. |
| `lifecycle` | A superseding decision, a completed plan with a first-line Superseded banner, and an active-frontmatter design with a historical banner at the start of its body. Current replacements make ranking expectations explicit. |
| `external` | Both a Markdown link and an inline path to `research_runs/x/result.json` outside docs. |

`init_baseline.rs`, `index_baseline.rs`, and `history_baseline.rs` protect existing
CLI behavior. Adaptive coverage, CJK body fragments and historical ranking have
separate regression tests in `adaptive_coverage.rs` and `query_retrieval.rs`.

`queries.json` is the 35-query retrieval evaluation corpus. Each record has:

- `fixture`: one of the five repositories above.
- `query`: the complete query string to replay.
- `expected_paths`: nonempty relevant targets, relative to the fixture root. A
  top-3 hit means at least one of these paths occurs among the first three results.
- `category`: control, relaxed (one missing term), cjk, mixed, identifier, or lifecycle.
- `not_first_paths` (optional): historical paths that must not rank first; check
  this constraint separately from top-3 relevance.

`fixture_corpus.rs` validates structure and target paths. `query_retrieval.rs`
replays the corpus against the frozen S4 baseline: zero zero-hit queries, all
queries hitting an expected path in the top three, and at least 34/35 top-one
hits. Do not weaken expected target paths to make regressions pass. Release
smoke runs should also copy each of the five repositories before running index,
check, `context --current` and query.

`compat/` contains serialized compatibility assets, not a sixth project fixture:

- `alpha6-schema.yaml` is an unchanged copy of the bundled schema at commit
  `2488796f4c1386d260a3b3508e80da7bf84bb87d` (`0.1.0-alpha.6`).
- `alpha6-history/` was generated by that commit's CLI using two tiny synthetic
  documents. Preserve its snapshot JSON, object bytes, hashes, and latest ref as
  a frozen input: regenerating it with the implementation under test would no
  longer prove that old snapshots can still be listed, diffed, and restored.

[Weave W0](weave/README.md) adds a separate multilingual history generator and
retrieval/drift/cochange expectation corpus. Its Git repository is created only
in temporary storage at test time; no nested `.git` directory is stored here.
The runner validates inputs and marks future behavior evaluations as pending.
